verse.text: So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for the Lord, for you know that nothing you do for the Lord is ever useless.

video.title: Stand Firm | 1 Corinthians 15:58 | One Verse Daily Devotional

reflection: Fatherhood rarely feels dramatic — it's a thousand ordinary days of showing up, working the job, coaching the team, praying over the kids, even when nobody's clapping. Paul's charge to stand firm and keep working reminds us that none of that quiet, faithful labor is wasted, even when we can't see the fruit yet. Stay steady, dad — the Lord sees what you're building.
